scope: Declared before complete development inference and before viewing calibration or test responses.
extrapolation: Fixed cubic-order extrapolation: u_f+(u_f-u_c)/((n_f/n_c)^3-1); validated against independently qualified development solutions, not assumed exact.
selection: First candidate whose worst development RMS forward error AND tensor-interpolation error are <=30 micrometres; otherwise no inference seal.
reason: Avoid relying on a large fitted discrepancy to conceal physical-parameter bias from a coarse solver. Development-only residual covariance remains modeled after selection.
